title: Q-CTRL
summary: Vancouver company selling quantum control and error-suppression software across hardware platforms.
bodyHtml:
Q-CTRL builds control software that improves the performance of quantum hardware by shaping the signals that drive qubits, plus tools for quantum sensing and education.

Its approach is hardware-agnostic: the same control layer can run on superconducting, trapped-ion or neutral-atom machines.

Why it matters

  • Qubit control optimisation
  • Error suppression
  • Quantum sensing applications

businessMeaning: Hardware makers would rather buy a control stack than rebuild one. That makes control software a horizontal layer across a fragmented hardware market.
investmentLens: Private; revenue tracks quantum hardware deployments rather than hype cycles.
